description.value:
These diminutive beastmen reside together with the civilized races of Vana'diel, easygoing and cheerful with a knack for trade, despite difficulty speaking common language.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Qiqirns gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, and -2 Wisdom.
  • Size: Qiqirns are Medium creatures.
  • Type: Qiqirns are Humanoid creatures with the qiqirn subtype.
  • Base Speed: Qiqirns have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Qiqirns begin play speaking Common and Qiqirn. Qiqirns with high Intelligence scores can choose Aquan, Draconic, Kindred, Orc, Terran, and Yagudo.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Curiosity: Qiqirns gain a +4 bonus on Diplomacy checks to gather information, and Knowledge (history) and Knowledge (local) become class skills.
  • Silver Tongued: Qiqirns gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff checks.
  • Sociable: Qiqirns can try to influence a creature a second time even if 24 hours have not passed, after failing a Diplomacy check by 5 or more.

Movement Racial Traits

  • Sprinter: Qiqirns gain a 10-foot racial bonus to speed when charging, running, or withdrawing.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Claws: Qiqirns receive a pair of claws they can use as natural weapons, dealing 1d4 points of damage.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Scent: Qiqirns gain the scent ability.
